text: Battlecry: Your opponent's spells cost (1) more next turn.

abilities.label: BATTLECRY
abilities.span: Battlecry: Your opponent's spells cost (1) more next turn.

dependencies.detail: Whether spells in the opponent's deck also cost (1) more during that turn; observable only through effects that read costs in the deck.
dependencies.source_needed: Power.log of a deck-cost effect during the affected turn

decisions.question: Which turn is 'next turn'?
decisions.discriminating_case: Played on your turn: the opponent's 1-cost spell costs 2 on their following turn and 1 on yours.

decisions.question: Do spells the opponent draws during that turn cost more too?
decisions.discriminating_case: The opponent draws a 1-cost spell at the start of the affected turn: 2 under yes, 1 under no.

decisions.question: Which zones' spells change cost?
decisions.discriminating_case: A 'draw your highest-cost spell' effect during that turn sees different costs.

notes: CARD-IR-V02 expressivity example. 'dynamic' follows the Loatheb analogy in CARD_AUDIT 3.8.
